prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its lower center, the left tail lamp housing is shattered, and the trunk lid shows a crease running toward the driver side. The pattern of the damage lines up with the impact reported at the scene, and nothing I found points to older harm on this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, repair and refinish the trunk lid, and recalibrate the parking sensors. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this work, and the invoices submitted contain no repeated line items. I recommend approving the estimate as written.
